label: def:torus-knot-top-channel-decoration
title: Top-channel decoration $\delta^{\mathrm{top}}_q(T_{m,p}) = q^{w} - q^{-w}$ of a torus knot
html:
Let T_{m,p} be a positive torus knot presented on its braid index, so that m \le p, as the closure of the braid \beta_{m,p} = (\sigma_1\sigma_2\cdots\sigma_{m-1})^{p} \in B_m. Its writhe is w = (m-1)p. In the trivial one-dimensional representation of H_m(q), where every \sigma_i acts by q, the braid acts by q^{w}. The top-channel decoration of T_{m,p} is the bar-odd part of this eigenvalue under the bar involution q \mapsto q^{-1}:

  \delta^{\mathrm{top}}_q(T_{m,p})
  \;:=\;
  q^{w} - q^{-w},
  \qquad
  w = (m-1)p.

The braid-index condition m \le p is part of the definition. T_{m,p} and T_{p,m} are the same knot, but (m-1)p \ne (p-1)m when m \ne p, so without the condition one knot would receive two values.

This is a scalar in R = \mathbb{Z}[q^{\pm 1}]. It is a different object from the q-dimension decoration \delta_q(b) = (\chi_\lambda(b))_{\lambda \vdash n} of q-dimension decoration \delta_q, which is a tuple of characters, and it is not the sum of that tuple. The two agree for m = 2: for odd p the characters of \beta_{2,p} = \sigma_1^{p} on V_{(2)} and V_{(1,1)} are q^{p} and (-q^{-1})^{p} = -q^{-p}, whose sum is q^{p} - q^{-p}. They disagree for m = 3. For T_{3,5} the characters of (\sigma_1\sigma_2)^{5} on V_{(3)}, V_{(2,1)}, V_{(1,1,1)} are q^{10}, -1, q^{-10}, whose sum is q^{10} - 1 + q^{-10}, while \delta^{\mathrm{top}}_q(T_{3,5}) = q^{10} - q^{-10}.
